research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Mysten Labs is researching secure authentication methods for web3 applications, as indicated by the work titled Zero-knowledge proofs for login. This technology enables users to log in using the OpenID Connect protocol while maintaining anonymity through the use of zero-knowledge proofs, programmatically combining information from an OpenID provider with an anonymous user account ID. Their research focuses on enhancing security and privacy in decentralized environments.

about_short_description.short_description: Mysten Labs develops tools that make web3 secure, reliable, and ready for mass adoption.

product.name: Sui
product.description: A permissionless Layer 1 blockchain for developing and running decentralized applications with high transaction speed and low costs.

product.name: Move
product.description: A programming language used to build secure, performant, and feature-rich blockchain applications on Sui.

product.name: Walrus
product.description: A decentralized storage and data availability protocol for storing and retrieving large binary files, known as blobs.

product.name: Enoki
product.description: A platform that lets businesses integrate blockchain and digital asset functionality into their existing applications.

product.name: Seal
product.description: A decentralized secrets management service that encrypts data and applies on-chain access policies to control decryption.

product.name: DeepBook
product.description: An on-chain order book and decentralized finance infrastructure layer that provides liquidity and trading functionality on Sui.
